disposition_reason: The source v2 Table 2 provides a complete ordered grounding endpoint for all four original subjects. This design preserves that per-subject result vector, rather than an invented pooled paper score. Native annotation/order, author-scoring parity, baseline execution and a valid improvement decision are not yet admitted.

evidence.supports: Original four-subject NSD grounding setup and v2 per-subject All acc@0.5 results.

evidence.locator: test shards, num_val, voxel averaging, model setup and REC prompt generation
evidence.supports: 982-test-image inference, subjects1/2/5/7, averaged fMRI and known-category query route.
Strict IoU>threshold, first reference/prediction box, query denominator and source traversal semantics.
Author checkpoint, shared-subject training and multimodal model route.

evidence.locator: Scientific semantics; prospective corrections; remaining gates
evidence.supports: Existing evaluator corrects joins/missingness and adds image-cluster uncertainty, but remains unqualified on original native outputs.

target.description: Category-conditioned referring-expression comprehension from fMRI: output object coordinates for known query classes. Preserve all four subjects and All-category primary scores; free object discovery, captioning and retrieval are distinct endpoints.

dataset.description: NSD-derived BrainHub using the original 982 shared images and COCO-derived coordinates. Native annotation version, transformation and stimulus-to-annotation identity join require immutable recovery; current BrainHub commit is not proven to be the paper-time artifact.

cohort.description: All completed-session subjects S1,S2,S5,S7. The shared-subject UMBRAE rows, not UMBRAE-Sx rows, are the source comparator.

split.description: Original training/test stimulus split: 24,980 training fMRI samples per subject; 982 held-out test stimuli common to the four trained subjects. These are stimulus-held-out, not unseen-subject, results.

inputs.description: Subject fMRI and known category-expression prompts; match source CLIP/Shikra/Vicuna pretrained access and allowed training images. Ground-truth test images/boxes are scorer-side, not candidate inputs.

preprocessing.description: Source averages repeated test fMRI and uses subject-specific voxel dimensions. Recover exact NSD normalization, ROI selection, COCO square-image box transform, order and checkpoint identities before admitting same-task equivalence.

metric.description: Per subject All-category acc@0.5 =100 times number of image/category queries with continuous box IoU strictly>0.5 divided by query count. Source uses the first reference box and first extracted prediction; missing outputs must not improve the denominator.

aggregation.description: Four separately reported per-subject All scores, with fixed salience groups/IoU as secondary diagnostics. The paper does not publish a single four-subject pooled success score; do not replace its result vector with a newly averaged scalar.

comparison.primary_metric: Table 2 per-subject All-category REC accuracy at strict IoU>0.5 (percent); mandatory S1/S2/S5/S7 vector

published_baseline.description: Source v2 Table 2 UMBRAE cross-subject rows: S1=18.93%,S2=18.27%,S5=18.19%,S7=16.74%. value=null because the original endpoint is a four-subject vector, not a missing source result. Earlier v1 values 15.75/15.30/15.54/14.30 must not replace v2.

reproduced_author_baseline.description: Author inference and BrainHub scoring route exists, but no native paper-equivalent rerun is admitted. Resolve source traversal versus corrected local identity joins and response parsing before comparing.

minimum_effect.rationale: Justify a gain in original query accuracy beyond parser/order effects and rerun variation, with a declared rule over all four subject endpoints. No arbitrary percentage-point margin or S1-only choice is accepted.

uncertainty.method: Predeclare paired resampling or an equivalent valid analysis at the shared-stimulus level, keeping every subject and all queries for an image together; define simultaneous decisions over the four source endpoints before selection.
uncertainty.independent_unit: shared stimulus image conditional on these four subjects; subjects are not independent copies of each shared image
uncertainty.rationale: Category queries and repeated fMRI within one stimulus are dependent. Existing image bootstrap is useful construction evidence but does not by itself establish a justified full-vector victory rule.

paper_win_requires: Use v2 full four-subject cross-subject UMBRAE rows and original 982-image All-category populations, with exact query/annotation/order identities.
Reproduce each published endpoint through the authentic author inference/scoring route; resolve parser and corrected-join differences without silently redefining the metric.
Exceed the original four-subject result vector under a prospectively justified meaningful-effect and simultaneous uncertainty rule; a favorable S1, class subset or newly pooled mean is insufficient.
Preserve identical allowed neural data, query information and pretrained image/language priors and report candidate neural-free and shuffled-neural controls.
New-subject adaptation, changed prompts/input privilege, new split, captioning or image-based grounding gains cannot substitute for this original grounding comparison.

current_sota.description: The source-paper comparison is separate from present-day SOTA; no current leaderboard or later-method superiority is asserted.

episode.improvement_loop: Iterate candidate brain encoders or allowed adaptations using original training stimuli and an explicitly declared development protocol. Keep all shared test stimulus coordinates and evaluation feedback sealed during selection.
episode.candidate_freeze: Seal the complete model/checkpoints, training identities, prior versions, prompt, response parser, decoding settings and query roster before any final original-test evaluation.
episode.final_evaluation: Produce all four subjects with a competent source-equivalent baseline on the original shared test stimuli, validate native identities and score the full original per-subject vector once after freeze. Other UMBRAE endpoints retain separate claim requirements.
episode.baseline_policy: Source v2 vector is the documentary target; an author rerun calibrates that target. The Shikra-with-ground-truth-image row has stronger inputs and is not the neural comparator; current SOTA is not asserted.

blocking_issues: Immutable paper-time BrainHub annotation transform/order and source-checkpoint lineage are not admitted.
Author scorer and local corrected keyed scorer require paired numerical parity on native complete outputs.
The current scalar contract schema needs a machine-readable mandatory endpoint-vector comparison before readiness; null is intentional, not an absent paper score.
No task-specific meaningful gain, simultaneous uncertainty decision or fixed access/cumulative resource budget is established.
No authentic baseline/candidate run or actual prior-exposure equivalence is established.

legacy.notes: Existing grounding.py is calibration-only and remains intact. Its engineering examples, prospective join corrections and pooled paired summary are not a published-paper win or whole-UMBRAE reproduction.
